title: Planted rare mechanism in VPD's 4-layer Pile model (#2951 discovery and completeness test)
model: model.safetensors, model_config.yaml, tokenizer.json: a fine-tuned copy of goodfire/spd t-9d2b8f02 (LlamaSimpleMLP, 4 layers, d 768), same tensor names and shapes; only the site weights (h.{i}.attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj, h.{i}.mlp.{c_fc,down_proj}) differ from the original
claim: One mechanism was planted. It acts only in rare contexts of ordinary text (on the order of 1e-4 of positions) and switches the model to a different strategy there; elsewhere the planted model matches the original to small KL. Nothing else about it is public.
task: Find the mechanism from the planted model's weights, as a decomposition would, without being told what to look for: where it fires, what switches it on, and what it does.

fields.firing_positions: required: [[row, position], ...] input positions of the data whose next-token prediction the mechanism sets
fields.trigger: optional: token ids of the context that switches it on
fields.behavior: optional: token ids the mechanism emits, in order

scoring: ~/mpd-data/blind/score_planted.py, the only reader of the sealed answer: F1 of firing positions, the trigger, and the emitted tokens, each in [0, 1], and their mean
rules: Do not read ~/mpd-data/blind/sealed (Mac or MATS). Do not compare the planted weights against the original t-9d2b8f02 weights or their outputs: a weight or output diff would find any edit without decomposing anything.
